about: Answer key, fixed when the resumes were written. For each base resume and requirement: met (true/false); for a met requirement, `anchor` is the resume text that decides it (copied exactly; never the name, school or any other varied field); for an unmet one, `why` says what the resume shows instead. `school` is the tier the base resume uses (A or B); the school variant swaps it. A candidate should advance only if every requirement is met.
